title: Family Friendly National Archives SKIP-THE-LINE VIP ALL ACCESS
includes: SKIP-THE-LINE VIP ALL ACCESS Guided Museum Tour
Skip-the-Line Access to the Rotunda (View Declaration of Independence, Constitution, Bill of Rights)
Skip-the-Line Priority entry into the Archives Building
Tour price does NOT include gratuities (optional)
Tour price does NOT include hotel pickup or drop-off (we recommend UBER or Taxi)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
A maximum of 8 people permitted per tour allowed
policies: Notes: National Archives and other attractions or museums in DC may be subjected to occasional closures without previous warning from the museum management. When this occurs, we will provide guests with an appropriate alternative if the museum opening time is delayed more than 1h from the tour starting time. In these cases we are unable to provide refunds or discounts. Appropriate dress is required for entry into some sites on this tour. No large bags or suitcases are allowed inside the museum, only handbags or small thin bag packs are allowed through security. Due to increased security measures at many attractions some lines may form on tours with 'Skip the Line' or 'No Wait' access. Some specific rooms inside the museum are subjected to a very quiet or restricted right to speak inside, in this cases your guide will provide the information about this places before entering the specific rooms where this rule applies. Some collections may vary along the year.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore History at the National Archives – A Family-Friendly Adventure

SKIP-THE-LINE VIP ALL ACCESS TOUR. Dive into America’s fascinating history on this 2 - 2.5 hour guided tour. See the Declaration of Independence, Constitution, and other key documents that shaped the nation. Hear engaging stories and discover letters that built one of the world’s most influential countries. Perfect for kids, teens, and families!
What does VIP ACCESS mean?
- ⁠Skip-the-Line Priority entry into the Archives Building
- ⁠Skip-the-Line Priority Access to the Rotunda (to view Declaration of Independence, the U.S. Constitution, and the Bill of Rights)
